description: This file defines API routes for a memory match card game using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, flipping, and resetting game sessions, along with associated data models and error handling.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Schema for standard error responses in the API.

classes.name: FlipRequest
classes.description: Model for the request body when flipping a card.

classes.name: ResetGameResponse
classes.description: Model for the response after resetting a game session.

methods.name: create_game
methods.description: Creates a new game session and returns its initial state.

methods.name: get_game
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a game session by its ID.

methods.name: flip_card
methods.description: Flips a card at a specified index within a game session.

methods.name: reset_game
methods.description: Resets an existing game session to a new one with the same board size.
